study type: Secondary analysis of prospectively collected observational data
cohort: Infants weighing 401 to 1500g admitted to Groote Schuur Hospital neonatal unit in South Africa between 2012 and 2020.
finding: The overall neonatal mortality rate was 19.8%, with higher rates associated with decreasing birthweight and outborn status, while the survival rate without major morbidity was 68.5% and comparable to developed countries.
